==Flavor Text==

''A fragrance of West winds, and of sunlight on green leaves''

==About==

Wild Garlic can be found in the wild or, with the [[Gardening]] Skill learned, grown by Planting another {{i|Wild Garlic}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Picking {{i|Any Flower}}s from the wild or Planting them in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. You may receive a {{i|Drone Bee}} or {{i|Queen Bee}} when Picking Any Flower from the wild. Wild Garlic restores the {{i2|Crustacea and Shellfish}} Food Group by 15% with a 80% chance when used as {{i|Any Garlic}} in a Food recipe. Wild Garlic be stored in either a {{i|Flower Sack}} or a {{i|Garlic Sack}}.
